Title: One Fine Day

Cast

1. Ishaan - 12 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Kavita - 35 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ishaan stands in the living room. Kavita stands near him.]

Ishaan: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ishaan knocks on the door.]

Ishaan: "I'm ready!"

[Ishaan slams the door shut.]

Ishaan: "What next?"

[Ishaan opens the window.]

Kavita: "And then?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Kavita stands near him.]

Ishaan: "Mom, look over here."

[Ishaan claps his hands.]

Ishaan: "I'm ready!"

[Ishaan nods.]

Ishaan (laughing): "Let's see."

[Ishaan whispers something to Mother.]

Ishaan (surprised): "Careful!"

[Ishaan gives Mother a flower.]

Ishaan: "Exactly right."

Scene 3: The park - Day

[Ishaan stands in the park. Kavita stands near him.]

Ishaan: "Mom, look over here."

[Ishaan goes jogging in the park.]

Ishaan: "Mom, listen!"

[Ishaan plays cricket in the park.]

Kavita: "Exactly right."

[Ishaan plays with his dog.]

Ishaan: "One more time!"

[Ishaan does yoga on a mat.]

Ishaan (excited): "I really enjoyed today."
